en: A Champion from Johto, here in Pewter? I heard you'd been making your way round Kanto.
I've been away breeding Pokémon, but rock is where my heart is. My Pokémon are as hard as the mountains.
Show me how a Champion breaks stone!
Well, I'll be. You broke right through. All right, take this: the Boulder Badge.
{player} received the Boulder Badge from Brock!
And take this. It's a move every Rock type should know.
TM80 is Rock Slide. It sends rocks tumbling down on the foe, and it may make them flinch.
There's more to rock than hardness. Patience, too. I'll be ready for you next time.
Hey, champ in the making! Brock's Pokémon are Rock types. Water and Grass moves will crumble them.
You beat Brock! The whole floor shook!

Pewter City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Brock
